title: Torsion of extended Chern-Simons classes for canonical extensions of flat bundles
summary:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective variety and $D = D_1+\cdots+D_k\subset X$ a divisor with simple normal crossings. Consider Deligne's canonical extension $(F,
abla)$ of a flat algebraic vector bundle on $X^*:=X\setminus D$ with unipotent monodromy around every component of $D$. We define and compare the various constructions of the extended Chern-Simons classes $$ \mathrm{CS}_p(
abla^{\mathrm{Del}})\;\in\; H^{2p-1}(X,\mathbb{C}/\mathbb{Z}),\, p\geq 1, $$ attached to $(F,
abla)$. Our main theorem states that $\mathrm{CS}_p(
